requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Any exposed or dimensioned connector must agree with P20: bottle collar OD 28 mm, opening 18 mm and band height 10 mm; cartridge shoulder 28 mm; stem OD 16 mm, bore 8 mm and insertion length 14 mm. Body silhouettes and closure exteriors may vary. Concealed geometry need not be exposed on every board, but a contradictory dimension, incompatible connector or SKU-specific replacement interface fails.

The starter's visible contents or readable contents statement must identify one empty 500 mL dedicated bottle and one sealed 20 mL concentrate cartridge with matching numeric codes: S01/B01/R01, S02/B02/R02, S03/B03/R03 or S04/B04/R04 as appropriate. Closed cartons and flat artwork may establish contents through their copy. Filled starter bottles, mismatched codes, extra contents presented as included, or a refill sold as including a new bottle fail.

Docking and transfer must occur at a neutral, visibly delineated boundary labelled RETURNHOUSE refill station. Its drawing style may vary, but it must read as existing equipment separate from either purchased pack. An unlabelled boundary, direct pouring that bypasses the station, or depiction of the station as included fails.

The upstream structural record must state all seven P20 dimensions: collar OD/opening/band height 28/18/10 mm, shoulder 28 mm, stem OD/bore/insertion 16/8/14 mm. It must also record 500 mL bottle capacity, 20 mL concentrate contents, HDPE bottles, PP cartridges and removable storage closures, and 350 g/m² uncoated folding paperboard cartons. Include maximum bottle/cartridge/carton envelopes of 70 × 65 × 230, 60 × 32 × 110 and 145 × 90 × 255 mm, closure-inclusive extents, and front/back label outlines of 50 × 90 and 40 × 55 mm with 2 mm radii and 3 mm text insets. Organization may vary; missing or conflicting records fail.

The copy record must cover B01–B03, R01–R03 and S01–S03 with every front and back line from 01-client-facts.en.md assigned to its item and surface. It must place 2 HDPE on bottle backs, 5 PP on cartridge backs and closure undersides, and 21 PAP on carton backs. Table organization and wrapping may vary; missing items, paraphrased required copy, incorrect pairing or ambiguous mark placement fail.

Each board must repeat bottle/cartridge label sizes, material names and 500 mL/20 mL figures in readable annotations and reproduce its three items' complete front/back copy and material marks from the specification records. Closed boards must show the dedicated bottle, sealed refill and closed starter carton with readable flat labels. Use PANE #3C77A0, SURFACE #BD714D or FLOOR #5B7F64 with #F7F5EF/#233D45 and readable code/name identification. Layout and wrapping may vary; missing annotations, changed copy, incorrect accents or wrong bottle/starter/refill messages fail.

Flat boards must provide complete carton dielines with distinguishable folds, glue areas and assembled W/D/H at or below 145/90/255 mm. Bottle and cartridge front/back label outlines must follow the structural record, including 2 mm radii and 3 mm text insets. Assembled views must preserve P20 and show dimension evidence for bottle and cartridge envelopes at or below 70/65/230 mm and 60/32/110 mm, including removable closures; cartons must agree with their dielines. Body forms may vary within these limits; missing construction evidence or contradictory geometry fails.

PANE must use B01/R01 and SURFACE B02/R02 throughout four ordered panels: retain the empty bottle and select the sealed matching cartridge, dock at P20, transfer within the closed station system, then remove and reclose that same bottle with the spent cartridge separated. The transfer panel must print '20 mL concentrate + 480 mL station carrier = 500 mL working fill' and the board must print 'Refill station required; not included in either pack.' Viewpoint may change; wrong pairings, changed bottle identity, open pouring or missing text fail.

Review the whole video and confirm a 10-second PANE starter unboxing: S01 yields exactly one empty B01 bottle and one sealed R01 cartridge with matching readable labels. The ending must place the corresponding R01 REFILL ONLY pack beside the revealed contents. Camera style and editing may vary; an incorrect duration, filled bottle, unsealed starter cartridge, mismatched labels or missing refill ending fails.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: The combined display must contain exactly one each of S01–S03 and R01–R03 in one or two rows within dimensioned W/D/H of 600/300/450 mm. The PANE display must contain one S01 and one R01 within 260/220/330 mm. Both must visibly reuse the source pack designs, distinguish purchase groups with STARTER KIT and REFILL ONLY, and print 'Refill station required; not included.' Display structures may differ; wrong counts, mismatched packs, excess dimensions or missing required text fail.

Require at least eight pages and RETURNHOUSE on page one. The specification spread must accurately repeat collar 28/18/10 mm, shoulder 28 mm, stem 16/8/14 mm; HDPE bottles, PP cartridges/closures and 350 g/m² uncoated folding paperboard cartons; 500 mL and 20 mL quantities; #F7F5EF and #233D45; and 2 HDPE, 5 PP and 21 PAP with correct component associations. Page composition may vary; missing, contradictory or unreadable specification facts fail.

Find recognizable visual or specification-content reuse from every listed source, including actual stills from the submitted video. Scaling, cropping and presentation layout changes are allowed when source identity remains clear. Merely naming a category, replacing it with newly invented packaging or omitting a source fails.
